newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: PRESS DIGEST - South Korean newspapers - June 19.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - South Korean newspapers - June 19.

text.p: The following is a summary of major stories in leading South Korean newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Seoul. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.

- The government official warned that unionised employees of the Bank of Korea and three financial watchdog organization will face stern legal punishment if they take collective action in protest against financial reform measures.

- A serious conflict is expected to engulf the ruling New Korea Party as the party's largest faction joined hands to press for the resignation of Party Chairman Lee Hoi-chang, a leading presidential hopeful.
- Lee Hong-koo, one of the eight presidential hopefuls of the New Korea Party, dropped out of the nomination race, calling on the party members to further strengthen their unity.
